legend.designed: a Leaf screen/overlay designs this surface (see leaf + demo)
legend.generic: no dedicated design, but a designed Leaf component covers it once the KOReader base widget is restyled globally
legend.partial: designed in part; a state or sub-surface is missing
legend.priority: P1 daily reading/library use, P2 occasional, P3 rare/power-user (gaps only)
